hero.name: Hithesh SVSK
hero.title: Full-Stack Developer | Trading Systems & Web Apps
hero.summary: Builds real-time trading observation systems, business web apps and multilingual Vue apps, from Python backends to polished Vue frontends.

about.intro: I build full-stack software end to end: Python services that watch markets in real time, and React and Vue frontends for businesses and everyday users. My trading tools are observation-first, so every signal is reviewed by a person before any trade is placed. Alongside them I co-founded PawSattva and built AquaKart, two production web apps serving real customers.

focus.title: Trading systems
focus.body: Signal engines for gold and silver on MT5 and MCX, with Discord interfaces and outcome tracking.

focus.title: Business web apps
focus.body: Customer-facing platforms like PawSattva’s feed planner and the AquaKart catalogue.

focus.title: Multilingual apps
focus.body: Hindi, English and Telugu content with text-to-speech in Mantra Darshan.

featured.title: Aureon Beast: Gold & Silver Trading Observation System
featured.pitch: Watches gold and silver in real time, posts signals to Discord, and waits for a human to confirm before any trade is placed.
bullets: Real-time signal engine for XAUUSD and XAGUSD on M5 with EMA cross, wick and volume-profile analysis
Discord command interface (/execute-trade, /status, /monitor, /remind price) with human-confirmed trade execution; detections never auto-trade
Trade lifecycle tracking and automated weekend performance reviews
Migrated state from Firestore to local PostgreSQL with Parquet candle archive and optional Supabase mirror

projects.title: Aureon MCX: Commodity Futures Signal Bot
bullets: MCX GOLD and SILVER futures observation with multi-timeframe context (M5, M15, H1, H4)
Dynamic SymbolResolver instead of hard-coded contract IDs
Read-only Discord signal cards with final-check step; MFE/MAE outcome learning

projects.title: PawSattva: Pet Nutrition Web App
bullets: Co-founder and developer of a pet nutrition platform
Built the Pet Feed Planner: multi-step consultation form (Pet Parent → Pet Profile → Body Condition → Feeding Details)
Supports personalised diet plans for maintenance, weight loss and weight gain

projects.title: AquaKart
